blocks.name: The leverage line
blocks.plain: One act still moves more than any other, and another night of building did not change it. BOLO 24 is finished work: the character sheet, the Season 1 beats, the gates table, the slice pipeline, S4-01 rendered. D-9, D-6, D-7 and D-5 are all ruled. What is left is a date. Name the launch month and four open calls stop being questions, because every one of them is measured from it.

strand.last: Overnight 9/16 into 9/17 the Command built its own doors: JUDY's loop closed (wire, session voice, the reader), the launch and closing sequences were ruled and built, the address became Chief across 276 files, and DOPE SHEETs 56 and 57 went out. This morning the launch sequence ran for the first time: five stations GO, and the send pad became the only thing that sends.
strand.plan: Stand the Command up with one word, then bring the board to Chief without the main line reading a file.
strand.you: You said 'launch startup sequence', switched JUDY to goon time and asked for it as the default, and ruled that talk fills the box and the pad above it sends.
strand.next: Name the launch month for BOLO 24. It is the thirteenth day the main effort has waited, and nothing built this week is on its critical path. Blocked #11 (BOLO 29 against 57) still needs a read of DOPE SHEET 57 before it can be ranked.

blocks.why: The slice is finished work parked on an unanswered date, and this week keeps proving the build capacity is not the constraint: a voice loop, a launch sequence, a closing sequence and two DOPE SHEETs landed in one night. Six rows in Block V are still blocked, some since March, and the main effort has now idled thirteen days. The bottleneck is the ruling that releases work already sitting done, and every one of 24's four remaining calls is measured from the launch month.

blocks.name: The SOI card
blocks.plain: The words that run this operation. Say one and the protocol fires. Every term on this page is a live link; hover it, hold, and the definition opens. The full book is the SOI: the BREVITY.

strand.last: Ruled 9/11: DOPE SHEET (the status page) · SOI is the book · "the house tongue" and "glossary" retired · dark is the only theme.
strand.plan: The SOI page replaces the in-page glossary once it publishes (Charlie Mike pages, step 4). BOLO 37 moves rulings into a daily loop.
strand.you: You clarified FRAGO on your own read of doctrine: the update, never the page.
strand.next: Confirm OPORD as the page's word. Name the loop; MINT is the recommendation.
